name: typofix
description: Checks the spelling and grammar of your prompt as you type, with 3 fixes for each mistake, and rewrites the whole draft with Haiku when you ask.

language.title: Spelling language
language.description: A language or dictionary name such as en_US or de_DE. On macOS, leave empty to detect the language automatically. On Linux, it picks the enchant-2 or hunspell dictionary.

hunspell.title: hunspell dictionary
hunspell.description: macOS only. If hunspell is installed, it also checks drafts in this dictionary's language, such as en_US or en_GB, to catch typos macOS accepts, and skips drafts in other languages. Default en_US. Set to off to not use hunspell.
